days.note: Easiest day of the trip. If you land late, this is the one to compress.
days.title: Golden Circle
days.summary: An easy first day. Three headline stops, all paved, all within an hour of each other.

night.name: At Faxi

days.note: Kleifarmörk is 37 km up a slow road off the ring — about an hour each way. It is the only card campsite between Vík and Djúpivogur, so the detour buys the card night. Camping at Vík instead saves roughly 73 km and 2 h across today and tomorrow.
days.title: South coast waterfalls to Vík
days.summary: The postcard stretch. Short walks, black sand, and the two waterfalls everyone knows.

night.name: Kleifarmörk
night.facilities: Tent; Toilets; Cold water; Open fires forbidden; Waste; Sports field; Swimming pool; Supermarket; Restaurant; Golf; Gasoline; Hikes; Dogs on a leash allowed; Coffee shop; Chairs & Tables

days.note: The long one. Leave by 08:00. The card network has no site for the 330 km between Vík and Djúpivogur, which is exactly why this day is oversized — a non-card site at Höfn would split it neatly if you would rather.
days.title: Glaciers and the lagoon
days.summary: The longest driving day, and the best one. Start early.

night.name: Tjaldvæðið Bragðavöllum
night.facilities: Chairs & Tables; Hot water; Cold water; Shower; Toilets; Waste

days.note: Deliberately short to recover from day 3. Slack here if you want to add Petra’s Stone Collection or a fjord swim.
days.title: East fjords to Stuðlagil
days.summary: Quiet fjord road, then inland to the basalt canyon.

night.name: Studlagil Canyon

days.note: Mývatn midges are gone by September but the smell at Hverir is not. Nature Baths take a booking.
days.title: Dettifoss and Mývatn
days.summary: Iceland's most powerful waterfall, then the geothermal lake district.

days.note: Long transit after the whales. Whale watching (~3 h) versus the museum (~1.5 h) shifts your departure by over an hour — agree a regroup time at the harbour before you split.
days.title: Húsavík whales, then west
days.summary: Split the morning in Húsavík, regroup at the harbour, then the long transit west.

split.note: Both options leave from the same harbour, about 100 m apart — regroup on the quay.

options.book: Walk in. Leaves time for the town and a coffee.
